lines: A customer! I'm Otis Gumdrop, toy maker!
The festival! Best night of the year!
Scarecrow Sam waved at me. I think.
The Summer Fair! Best night of the year!
Scarecrow Sam winked at me. I think.
The festival! Best night of the year!
Scarecrow Sam waved at me. I think.
The Spring Fair! Best night of spring!
Scarecrow Sam waved at me. I think.
A new spinning top! ...Oops. It fell over.

rotate: My clockwork mice run in circles. They have ideas.
My toy rocket flew over the oak and never came down.
Gizmo made the gizmos. I made the gumdrops!
That bear's Captain Biscuit. Ducks are his enemy.
